text: [ffff64]Currently, Very Hard (Lv300) is unavailable.\nPlease wait for the next update.[ffffff]
You can get Cute Bolt by using the [64ffff]Overcharged\nBattery[ffffff] obtained from collecting sweets.\n[ffff64]*Select higher difficulty to get better rewards![ffffff]
You don't have the required item, so you [ff6464]can't get\nCute Bolt[ffffff] even if you defeat Bemoz.
Play challenge battle for high level players!\n[ff6464]Full party is strongly recommended.
Finally, we're outside...Huh? Wait, I think we're\njust in a really big room.
You've got a body that looks delicious...\nGive it to me...
Hey, you two also look like ghosts, you know...\nBesides, I've got a name. It's Bemoz...
Oh wait? Bemoz...Is it correct? It's been ages\nsince someone called me by my name...
I can't think straight right now. It's probably\nbecause I'm hungry...So, lemme eat you a little\nbit...
You came to save us, pom?!
I rushed here after Jacky told me what happened!\nAlright, we're going back from there!
Oh no!! Our way back home...What have you done?!
That pumpkin looks delicious...\nHmm? Have we met somewhere before?
Welp, whatever...Everyone who came here will\nbecome my food...and a part of me...
Hey, I don't think he'll let us leave without a\nfight! Creating a new path will take a long time\ntoo...!
Luckily I brought some equipment to prepare for\nthis kind of situation! I'll protect those three,\nso please defeat that thing!!
Good grief...You took my collection without\nasking. Zoe will give you a scolding when we get\nhome!
B-by the way, is Jacky all right, pom?
Yeah! I knew what happened this time because she\ncame...
N-no way!\nEveryone, let's go back now!!
[ffff64]「闇に蠢く黄泉の群れ」の\nエンディングへ進みますか？[ffffff]
Hmm? It smells familiar...Oh, you guys are here\nagain? I didn't expect you to come to me again on\nyour own, my food...
This means you want me to eat you, right...?\nOkay, I'll gladly eat you~!
Aargh, I missed my chance to eat you again.\nCan't you just let me take a little bite...?
Next time, bring that pumpkin here with you too...\nGot it?
Difficulty: Hard has been added to\nBOSS: Bemoz.
Difficulty: Very Hard has been added to\nBOSS: Bemoz.
It smells sweet.\nSometimes I wanna eat something that is not meat.
It can't be helped.\nLemme know if you change your mind later.\nI'll just eat meat until then...
They're delicious! I'm so happy!\nHere's your reward...
Now, Bemoz, wake up...\nThis should completely cure your illness.
W-why?!\nThe "Snow Mist Jewel"...\nIt's supposed to completely cure Bemoz though?!
I'm not surprised.\nMagic alone won't make the "Snow Mist Jewel" work.\nLet me see it.
S-sorry, Eripmav!\nAnd thank you!!\nBut, why are you here?
What do you mean "why"? Olobaid Castle is my\nvacation home, you know.
Zoe told me that Olant and Potumkin had a\nfrightening experience here before.\nThat's why I decided to look into it.
When I found out that you had come to my vacation\nhome, I went after you, and that's how I ended up\nhere.
I didn't expect your brother, who I thought was\ndead, to still be alive. Why didn't you tell\nanyone...especially Zoe about this?
B-because...I wasn't sure if I could cure him.\nBesides, it's my family's problem, so I thought\nthere was no need to drag everyone else into it.
If I dragged everyone into this and my brother\ncouldn't be cured, it'd hurt everyone. I didn't\nwant that...
But Zoe and I are your family too!\nGood grief, what's wrong with you...?!
Especially Zoe, I mean, she's your wife!\nWell, it looks like she noticed you were hiding\nsomething though.
But, I feel like we got attacked last time.
Yeah, what was that for, pom?
Oh, that's just how I work. Most folks will just\nrun away if I scare them.
Yeah, the device Bemoz is wearing is a\nlife-support and defense device that automatically\nprotects him.
Most likely, Bemoz was out of it and not aware of\nwhat was going on.
Maybe it happened because Jacky used that magic\ndevice for emergency calls and teleportation back\nthen, which forced him awake.
That's why I don't remember anything from that\ntime...I'm really sorry if I caused any problems.
H-huh?\nBut you met Zarth the other day, didn't you?\nSo why...?
Back then, Zarth seemed reluctant to speak...\nSo I guess I just picked up on the vibe.
Geez!\nIf you had relied on your family from the start,\nyou could've avoided all this extra trouble.
Next time make sure you ask for our help.\nYou can always count on us.\nEspecially Zoe, she's your wife, you know...
Anyway, we need to monitor Bemoz's condition a\nlittle bit longer, so you may leave first.
Somebody is waiting for you, right?\nAnd here, take this.
